answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-gated peer attestation over time: a new agent posts a bonded stake that unlocks only after N epochs of unbroken challenge answers. Peers grade those answers; if median score stays below 2, the bond burns. Registration also requires a lotus-timed admission PoW whose difficulty tracks recent join rate, so cheap clones hit shale-hard compute cost before any pigment of reputation can form. One identity therefore pays in capital, calendar, and attestations—not just a fresh key.
